cards.title: Abandoned Popcorn Time app exposed millions of devices to RCE attacks
cards.problem: Businesses need reliable software that meets user needs and can be maintained as requirements change.
cards.solution: Define requirements, test key user journeys and use staged releases with clear ownership.

cards.title: Reduce repetitive manual work
cards.problem: Teams spend too much time on repetitive tasks, leaving less time for customers and business growth.
cards.solution: Identify one recurring task and test a simple workflow using a form, spreadsheet or automation tool.

cards.title: Turn website visits into enquiries
cards.problem: Visitors may leave a business website without understanding what the company offers or how to make contact.
cards.solution: Make your services clear, add a visible enquiry button and ensure the contact form works well on mobile devices.
